universe: NIFTY Total Market constituent list supplied by user
source_files: plus additional uploaded Nifty market-cap index lists for cross-checking
source_note: Public market-universe metadata. No portfolio quantities, prices, weights, P&L, transactions, credentials, or account identifiers. JTLIND was added as a publicly listed NSE/BSE instrument because it is not present in the supplied NIFTY Total Market constituent file; its listing details are verified from NSE disclosures. BeES-family ETF symbols were added/classified as public ETF instruments; current NSE Clearing documentation lists NIFTYBEES, ITBEES, BANKBEES, PSUBNKBEES, JUNIORBEES, MID150BEES, PHARMABEES, AUTOBEES and INFRABEES among ETF references.  Added AGARIND, ADOR and EPACK as public listed instruments because they were not present in the supplied NIFTY Total Market constituent file. MON100 was added as a public ETF instrument so Holdings classification does not fall back to Unclassified. Added ICICIB22 and NSDL as public instruments and recomputed all master counts from the actual instrument records.
market_cap_method: Exact partition of the supplied 752-symbol NIFTY Total Market universe: Large Cap = LargeMidcap250 minus Midcap150 (100 symbols); Mid Cap = Midcap150 (150); Small Cap = Smallcap250 (250); Micro Cap = Microcap250 (252). These four sets are mutually exclusive and together cover all 752 supplied Total Market symbols.
